title: Indian Chicken Curry
instructions: Simmer the spiced chicken and tomato sauce until tender.

title: Roasted Salmon with Vegetables
instructions: Roast the salmon and vegetables on one sheet pan until cooked through.

instructions: Stir-fry the tofu and vegetables. This 10 minute dinner is ready fast.

instructions: Bake until the cookies are golden at the edges.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta and toss it with the tomato sauce and cheese.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
instructions: Cook the beef and vegetables slowly overnight until tender.

title: Mexican Grilled Shrimp Tacos
instructions: Grill the shrimp and serve them in tortillas with cabbage.

title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
instructions: Roast the vegetables, then toss them with greens and dressing.

instructions: Whisk the batter and cook each pancake in a skillet.

title: Classic Cheese Pizza
instructions: Bake the pizza until the crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbling.

instructions: Marinate the raw vegetables for five minutes before serving.

instructions: Bake the chicken and rice together in a casserole dish.

instructions: Simmer the broth and shrimp gently until the shrimp are cooked.

instructions: Roast the potatoes until crisp and golden.

instructions: Assemble the sandwich and serve it with a side salad.
